name: @node-projects/jszip
purpose: Browser builds only. vendor/pptxgenjs/package.json maps the engine's "@node-projects/jszip" import here for bundlers that honour the browser field; Node keeps the installed package's lib/index.js. This file is the package's own published bundle of lib/ (esbuild --bundle --minify --format=esm --platform=neutral --external:pako, its prepublish build), which reproduces byte for byte with esbuild 0.28.2. It differs from lib/ only in having no literal require("readable-stream") for bundlers to follow (lib/support.js probes it inside try/catch; in Node ESM the probe always fails).
